risk.formula: Disallowance at risk = test-period spend a commission could challenge: whole lines failing the reconciliation, approved-policy, FERC-account or used-and-useful tests (unless remediated), the unused share of seat purchases, and the share of a line equal to a savings estimate left unactioned for 60+ days. Evidence score = cost-weighted share of evidence present.
risk.disclaimer: Decision support for the regulatory team; not a prediction of any commission's order.

methodology: # Technology cost evidence: {filing}
{entity} ({jurisdiction}), {authority}. Test period {review_start} to
{review_end} (actuals); rate year {forecast_start} to
{forecast_end}. Prepared with MM CostIQ.
## Sources
Provider billing exports in FOCUS format (cloud and AI), SaaS vendor invoices (file drop), invoice detail, and the
company's reference registers (legal entities, allocation factors and policies, FERC account map, jurisdiction factors).
## Allocation (workpapers, one row per allocated charge)
1. Pool: cost center from split-cost allocation tags, resource tags or approved rules.
2. Operating company: first approved policy by priority; shares from the policy's allocation factor for the month, or
100% to a fixed entity.
3. Jurisdiction: the entity's jurisdiction factors.
4. Cost class: build work under an open work order to construction work in progress (account 107); recurring cloud and
SaaS fees to functional O&M.
5. FERC account: the company's account map.
Allocated totals tie to source totals for every period (control C-10).
## Test-year bridge (forecast_bridge.csv)
Test-period cost by vendor, annualized; the rate year adds contract escalators from each renewal date. Invoice
tie-out compares each vendor's invoices with its charges.
## Evidence tests (workpapers and risk_summary.csv)
Reconciled to the invoice line (within $1); allocated under an approved, effective-dated policy; mapped to a FERC
account; used and useful (no idle day, unused commitment or unused seat share) unless remediated by an implemented
optimization; no known savings left unactioned for 60+ days.
## Integrity
approvals.csv lists the ledger entries for every policy, optimization and exhibit decision with their hashes.
ledger_certificate.json records that the hash chain verified and the last decision entry. The SHA-256 of this ZIP is
written to the ledger on export as `audit_file:{filing}`.
Decision support for the regulatory team; not a legal opinion or a prediction of any commission's order.
